turns.text: I ordered a custom print of the house where I grew up. It arrived Monday and I'd like to return it.

Îmi pare rău să aud că ați primit o comandă care nu vă mulțumește. Ca să verific comanda și politica de retur, am nevoie de numărul comenzii (SC- și patru cifre) și de adresa de e-mail folosită la plasarea ei.
That's SC-2214. The checkout email was rowan.bellwick@example.com.

Thank you, I've found order SC-2214. This is a custom commissioned print, and our policy does not allow returns for commissioned work, so I can't file a return for it. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, but this order doesn't fall under that rule. If the print has arrived damaged or is not what was agreed, I can file a damage claim for staff to review. Would you like me to do that?

items.title: The House Behind the Mulberry Gate

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
